BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to photovoltaic electrical systems; and adding anew section to chapter 19.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person with a valid limited energy system electriciancertificate or a valid telecommunications electrician certificate mayobtain an endorsement from the department allowing the person toinstall, maintain, replace, or repair photovoltaic electrical systems. (2) In order to obtain the endorsement, the person must provide thedepartment with proof of photovoltaic installer certification by theNorth American board of certified energy practitioners or an equivalentcertification board. (3) The scope of work under a photovoltaic electrical systemendorsement is limited to the installation, maintenance, replacement,and repair of photovoltaic electrical systems that generate a maximumof ninety volts and twenty-five kilowatts of power, and includes allelectrical wiring and electrical equipment used to create or convey p. 1 SB 5189photovoltaic energy up to and including the inverter. (4) The department may adopt rules to implement this section.
